Listed 2026-09-01; Class B shares, stock short name SHEIN-W (weighted voting rights). Offer 279,992,500 Class B shares, 100% primary ('Sale Shares' appears nowhere in the prospectus), gross HK$13,596.4m / net HK$13,214.1m. Shares upon Listing before the over-allotment option 4,246,202,609 (Class A + Class B). HK public 5.63x on 35,751 valid applications, international 2.59x on 106 placees; clawback NOT triggered, split held at 10/90. One-lot ballot 18.42% (2,820 of 15,312, Pool A). Sponsors Goldman Sachs (Asia), Morgan Stanley Asia, J.P. Morgan Securities (Far East). FINANCIALS (US$ x7.8): FY2025 net revenues US$41,847m, net income US$2,064m (FY2024 US$38,748m / US$3,365m — earnings FELL on higher revenue); 3M-2026 was a net LOSS of US$99m vs +US$395m a year earlier. Day 1 traded down to HK$43.72 (-10.0%) before closing HK$48.50, one tick under the offer, inside a live stabilisation mandate.
